column3: Description
Full‑screen notice with spinner and “Re‑try” button when the app detects offline status.
Scrollable emoji grid in a small modal anchored to text input.
Delayed hover reveals a mini card previewing linked content.
Swatch grid or hue slider panel appearing over its trigger.
Tall side drawer listing checkboxes for bulk filter selection.
A narrow panel that slides from the right, stacking recent toasts in one scrollable feed.
Dialog that keeps keyboard focus inside until closed—critical for accessibility.
Secure popup requesting password re‑entry before performing sensitive actions.
Small banner suggesting users install the web app to their device home screen.
Modal supports pinch‑zoom or scroll‑zoom on large images.
Small circular button that expands into a chat window overlaying the page corner.
Secondary modal opens above the first with overlay stacking handled elegantly.
Modal that advances through multiple screens with “Next” / “Back.”
Semi‑transparent layer with spinner covering entire app during async operations.
Dimmed background with a centered search input and instant results dropdown.
Off‑canvas panel sliding in from the left, typically holding navigation or filters.
Centered box with title, body, and primary/secondary buttons; background content is dimmed.
System‑style overlay listing social apps and actions for sharing a URL or file.
Small bubble that appears over a carousel slide, offering extra context or a link.
Centered modal with progress bar, preventing other interactions until complete.
A red bar that appears at page top after failed form submission, listing errors and linking to each field.
Mirrored version sliding from the right edge—often used for carts or details.
Red tooltip anchored to an input, showing the first validation error.
Dialog with an image or video on the left and a short form on the right.
Everything dims except a circular spotlight following cursor or focus target.
Brief message appearing at a corner and auto‑dismissing after a few seconds.
Appears when the cursor moves toward the browser bar, offering a last‑chance deal.
Slides up to cover the entire viewport—common for mobile pickers or forms.
Modal with explicit question and two balanced choices (“Delete / Keep”).
Bottom‑right handle lets users stretch the dialog to fit more content.
Bottom‑center bar showing a message plus a single action like “Undo.”
Browser permission overlay requesting approval to send notifications.
Dark overlay highlights one element at a time with “Next” arrows.
Full‑viewport dark overlay that centers the clicked image with prev/next arrows.
Visually hidden live‑region announcing state changes for assistive tech.
Compact menu near cursor with actions relevant to the clicked item.
A full‑width strip fixed to the top of the viewport for urgent messages like outages or launches.
Modal with accordions for toggling analytics, marketing, and personalization cookies.
Friendly error screen replacing the app UI when an unrecoverable exception occurs.
Calendar pops above input when focused, disappearing on selection.
Small tooltip with arrow pointing to a UI part, guiding first‑time users.
Narrow fixed panel that pushes main content aside rather than overlapping it.
Bottom sheet that glides up after task completion, asking users to rate or comment.
Diagonal ribbon across the viewport reminding admins they’re viewing as another user.
Toast displaying upload or save progress without disabling the UI.
Dark overlay framing a printable document preview with “Print / Cancel” buttons.
Users can grab the header to reposition the dialog within viewport bounds.
Wide dropdown that can fit images, multi‑column links, or promotions.
Panel that rises from the bottom to partial height, dismissible by swiping down.
Modal containing its own tab bar to organize multi‑section settings.
Small list of actions anchored under a button—closes when clicking outside.
Dimmed overlay confined to a specific panel while it refreshes.
Similar to image lightbox but embeds a responsive video player.
Semi‑transparent panel listing all hotkeys, invoked by pressing “?”.
Thin, persistent bar at the top signaling an active recording session.
Small label that appears on hover/focus, offering short contextual info.
Small modal demanding immediate user response—“OK” or “Cancel.”
Card‑style bubble anchored to an element, holding richer content than a tooltip.
Timed dialog showing days left on trial or subscription with “Renew” CTA.
Low strip at bottom explaining cookies with “Accept” / “Settings” buttons.
